column5: Blossom viewing: petals fall past a cherry branch across the moon.
A city after rain: drizzle over a skyline of lit windows, magenta beside cyan.
A winter wood: snow falling over cut-glass pines.
Under the surface: shafts of light swaying through the water, bubbles rising.
A reef in clear water: a shoal that turns together over swaying kelp.
A synth horizon: a grid running towards you from a striped sun.
A volcano at night: lava down its flank, embers rising.
A woodblock print: a great wave swelling in Prussian blue, a red sun over cream paper.
A festival evening: paper lanterns swaying on a branch, their light breathing.
A long exposure: gas clouds drifting across a dense starfield.
The longest evening: a low sun over swaying meadow grass, and fireflies once it is dark.
An Art Deco foyer: a sunburst in fine gold line, light running across its rays.
Midwinter: snow falling, and a string of fairy lights that glow in turn. Berry red on dark fir.
All Hallows: bats wheeling past an orange moon, a web in the corner.
New Year's Eve: fireworks opening one after another over a field of stars. Gold on midnight.
Lunar New Year: red lanterns swaying, gold sparks rising.
Hearts rising slowly, like bubbles. Peony pink on white.
The festival of lights: a row of oil lamps along the foot, flames alive, sparks rising.
Autumn: leaves coming down, turning as they fall, on warm paper.
Daylight in eight bits: clouds drifting over stepped hills, three hearts over a new thread. After dark, a crescent and square stars.
Torchlight on stone: brickwork fading down the wall, a torch burning in each corner, a key over a new thread.
Deep space: a ringed planet among square stars, and a saucer that hangs about.
A pocket console: the dot matrix showing through, and a small creature that hops and blinks.
A fire in the pines: flames flickering, embers going up, stars out.
Square fish gliding past, weed swaying, bubbles going up.
A model solar system: four planets on their rings round a sun, each keeping its own year, one with a moon.
Conway's Game of Life: two gliders crossing the chat a generation at a time, a blinker keeping time.
A circuit board: traces fanning out from a chip to their vias, signals running home along them.
Columns of hex falling down a green screen, their tails fading.
A space-filling curve, and two points of light working their way along all 1,023 of its turns.
A pendulum wave: eleven pendulums, each a little quicker than the last, falling in and out of step every ninety seconds.
The original: violet dusk over blue-black.
Warm stars over a desert horizon, dusty rose; a sun over the dunes by day.
A campfire night: warm stars and an ember-orange glow.
The sky seen from under water: ocean blue on abyssal blue.
A clearing at night: sage green on dark fir.
Late and purple: violet turning pink.
